papers.title_en: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
papers.evidence: 结合零成本代理的跨任务神经架构搜索
papers.tldr: 神经架构搜索成本高，跨任务迁移可复用历史知识，但稀疏搜索日志与任务特定迁移失败会削弱效果。该文提出风险鲁棒策略，将稀疏源日志与零成本代理结合，采用冠军初始化并联合预训练成对排序器。在TransNAS-Bench-101上，最差10%排名从290降至43（Micro autoencoding）、从465降至45（Macro room layout）。在13个cell-space目标中，10个目标均值与最坏表现优于仅代理排序器，显示稀疏历史下跨任务搜索的稳健性。
papers.abstract_en: Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

papers.title_en: Optimization, Optimal Control, and Reinforcement Learning for Robotics
papers.evidence: 融合优化、最优控制与强化学习的机器人控制
papers.tldr: 机器人学习常涉及优化、最优控制与强化学习，但三者关系分散、入门材料缺乏统一视角。本讲义以数学联系和工程应用为主线，系统梳理三类方法的共同基础与差异。内容由Yonghyeon Lee整理编辑，并采用人机协作方式撰写、组织与润色。当前版本是初步讲义合集，尚无图表且非完整教材，其意义在于为后续修订和系统学习提供可扩展框架。
papers.abstract_en: These lecture notes provide an introduction to optimization, optimal control, and reinforcement learning for robotics, emphasizing their mathematical connections and practical relevance. They present established material compiled and edited by Yonghyeon Lee, rather than new research results. The notes were developed through a human and AI collaborative writing process, with AI assistance in drafting, organizing, and refining the exposition. This first version is a preliminary collection of notes, not yet a fully developed textbook, and currently contains no figures or graphs. The notes may be revised, corrected, and expanded in future versions.

papers.title_en: GGraph: A GPU-Accelerated Library for Graph-Based Robot Deployment and Learning
papers.authors: Yash Rampuria, Rohan Garg, Daniele Gammelli, Marco Pavone
papers.evidence: 面向机器人部署与强化学习训练的GPU加速并行图库
papers.tldr: 自主移动机器人需要兼具几何与语义的稀疏图表示，但现有图库多面向单机部署或固定图，CPU构图难以支撑强化学习所需的大规模并行环境。GGraph是开源GPU加速图库，提供ROS 2真机接口、向量化GPU策略训练及3D导航、探索、闭环集成。单机图更新达毫秒级，并可让探索策略在数百个并行机器人上训练，将墙钟训练时间降低一个数量级。它为大规模机器人学习与部署提供统一图基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous mobile robots require spatial representations that capture geometry and semantics while staying sparse enough for planning in large, unknown environments. Graphs provide a natural representation for this purpose and underpin both classical planning methods and a growing class of reinforcement-learning (RL) policies. However, RL training needs hundreds to thousands of parallel environments, each constructing and updating its own graph. Existing graph libraries are typically designed for either single-robot deployment or fixed graphs, and CPU-based graph construction limits scalable training to only a few dozen environments. We introduce GGraph, an open-source GPU-accelerated graph library for both robot deployment and large-scale learning. GGraph supports real robots through ROS 2 interfaces and vectorized GPU-based policy training, with built-in support for tasks including 3-D navigation, exploration, and loop-closure integration. For single-robot operation, GGraph updates graphs in milliseconds. At scale, it enables graph-based exploration policies to train across hundreds of parallel robots, reducing wall-clock training time by one order of magnitude. Across simulation and real-world experiments, these results establish GGraph as a unified graph infrastructure for both large-scale robot learning and deployment.

papers.title_en: Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning
papers.authors: Tianzhe Chu, Druv Pai, Yi Ma
papers.evidence: 推广注意力算子的条件计算稀疏以实现高效Transformer
papers.tldr: MoE Transformer 依靠条件计算在每次前向中只激活稀疏权重，但其稀疏主要来自 MoE 算子。作者提出一种可类比泛化注意力算子的条件计算机制，使新稀疏与 MoE 稀疏自然嵌套，并构建 Nestor。在等算力和等稀疏度下，Nestor 的语言模型预训练优于传统 MoE，在长上下文与持续预训练中也更有效。该工作展示了替代条件计算机制在可扩展预训练中的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers, the standard backbone for modern large-scale deep learning, employ conditional computation: only a sparse subset of model weights is used in each forward pass. In MoE transformers, this sparsity arises in the MoE operator, which generalizes the multi-layer perceptron in the classical transformer. In this work, we explore an alternative mechanism for conditional computation that analogously generalizes the attention operator. The sparsity induced by this mechanism naturally nests (i.e., hierarchically composes) with the sparsity induced by the MoE operator. We show that a transformer employing this nested sparsity mechanism, which we call Nestor, performs better than a conventional MoE transformer at equal compute and equal sparsity in language model pretraining. We also show that Nestor is well-suited for continual pretraining: it can be adapted to longer contexts more effectively than conventional MoEs, as well as adapt more efficiently to new domains while forgetting less on old domains. Furthermore, we demonstrate that these benefits persist as model size, dataset size, and context length grow. Our results demonstrate the potential of alternative conditional computation mechanisms for deep neural network architectures. Code and checkpoints are available on GitHub at https://github.com/Ma-Lab-Berkeley/Nestor .

papers.title_en: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 带风险与不确定性干预的安全约束强化学习
papers.tldr: 真实世界强化学习可训练接触丰富操作，但在线试错中的不安全交互阻碍部署。SEVI 引入证据安全评论家，单次前向同时预测约束违规风险与认知不确定性；执行前过滤动作，风险高或证据不足时由离线恢复策略接管。在仿真与真实 USB 插入任务中，它取得最佳轨迹级安全预测、最高最终成功率与最低不安全事件数，并将不安全事件较恢复式安全 RL 降低 13.4%–57.1%。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world reinforcement learning has enabled contact-rich manipulation tasks to be trained directly on physical robots, but unsafe interactions during online learning remain a key barrier to practical deployment. We propose Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning (SEVI), a framework for reliability-aware safety intervention during real-world policy learning. SEVI introduces an Evidential Safety Critic that estimates both future constraint-violation risk and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass. During online learning, SEVI evaluates each task-policy action before execution; if the action is predicted to be unsafe or the prediction is insufficiently supported by evidence, SEVI overrides it with an offline-trained recovery policy that guides the robot toward a lower-risk region. We evaluate SEVI on two simulated manipulation tasks and a real-world USB insertion task under in-distribution and distribution-shifted conditions. Across task-learning and safety-critic baselines, SEVI achieves the strongest trajectory-level safety prediction, the highest final task success, and the lowest unsafe-event counts. SEVI also reduces unsafe events by 13.4 to 57.1 percent relative to recovery-based safe RL while preserving low-latency execution-time filtering. The project page is available at: https://sevi-safe.github.io/

papers.title_en: Conditional Flow Models for Offline Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Hao Cheng, Yuling Jiao, Lican Kang, Jerry Zhijian Yang, Chen Zhong
papers.evidence: 离线最大熵强化学习估计软动作价值函数
papers.tldr: 离线最大熵强化学习需从固定数据估计最优软动作值函数，但奖励分布与转移核未知使软Bellman算子难以直接计算。该文用基于概率流ODE的条件扩散模型分别估计奖励分布和转移核，构造数据驱动的软Bellman算子近似，并通过最小化经验Bellman残差学习Q*。作者给出非渐近误差界，包括条件流估计的全变差界和Hölder正则下的值学习风险界。实验验证了方法有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Offline maximum entropy reinforcement learning seeks to estimate the optimal soft action-value function \(Q^*\) from a fixed dataset without further interaction with the environment. Although \(Q^*\) is characterized by the soft optimal Bellman equation, the corresponding Bellman operator cannot be evaluated directly because both the reward distribution and the transition kernel are unknown. Consequently, estimating \(Q^*\) requires the joint treatment of environment modeling and value function learning. We propose a framework that addresses these tasks separately. Conditional diffusion models based on probability flow ODEs estimate the conditional reward distribution and transition kernel. The resulting distributional estimators define a data driven approximation of the soft optimal Bellman operator, whose empirical Bellman residual is minimized over a class of deep neural networks to estimate \(Q^*\). We establish nonasymptotic guarantees for the proposed method. For operator learning, we derive total variation error bounds for the conditional flow estimators that account explicitly for score estimation, numerical discretization, and terminal smoothing. For soft value learning, we first use the soft Bellman equation to show that $Q^*$ inherits Hölder regularity from the conditional reward and transition densities. For any Hölder index $β$, the value learning stage achieves an excess Bellman residual risk bound of order $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\big(n^{-\frac{2β}{d+2β}}\big),$ where $d$ is the total dimension of the state and action spaces. In contrast to many existing theoretical analyses of deep reinforcement learning, our results do not require Bellman completeness. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

papers.authors: Danilo Vucetic, Mohamad H. Danesh, Florence Clerc, Hsiu-Chin Lin, Jonathan Tremblay
papers.evidence: 用于仿真到现实迁移的正则化Actor-Critic强化学习
papers.tldr: 正则化强化学习虽具可证明鲁棒性，却未被sim-to-real流程广泛采用，弱正则的PPO仍是默认选择。作者提出基于soft mellowmax值函数的Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic（SMM-AC），系统评估常用算法在仿真到真实机器人迁移中的表现。MuJoCo上SMM-AC与SAC等基线相当，真实机器人上回报更高且对观测、环境与动力学扰动更鲁棒。结果表明正则化RL能提升真实部署鲁棒性，缓解sim-to-real差距。
papers.abstract_en: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) has provable robustness guarantees that should ease the transfer of policies from simulation to robots, known as sim-to-real. Yet, weakly regularised algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) remain the de facto choice in sim-to-real pipelines, while the practical benefits of regularisation for transfer remain poorly characterised. In this work, we study the sim-to-real performance of commonly used RL algorithms, with the aim of characterising the effects of regularisation on robotic performance. To that end, we derive Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic (SMM-AC), a novel regularised RL algorithm based on the soft mellowmax value function, which carries strong robustness guarantees. On MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks, SMM-AC is competitive with baselines like Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). On real robots, SMM-AC achieves higher return, while exhibiting greater robustness to perturbations in observations, the environment, and dynamics than baselines. Together, these results demonstrate that regularised RL improves real-world policy deployment through better robustness to the sim-to-real gap, and changing real-world conditions.

papers.title_en: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.authors: Zebin Xing, Yuhang Zheng, Yupeng Zheng, Yichen Zhang, Zichen Li, Shangqing Zhou, Yujie Zang, Yuchen Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Haoran Li, Qichao Zhang
papers.evidence: 作为交互式仿真器的动作条件视觉-触觉世界模型用于机器人策略学习
papers.tldr: 机器人策略评估与后训练依赖昂贵真实交互，而仅视觉世界模型可能误判接触动力学，难以可靠反馈。PhysCanvas面向接触丰富操作，将多视角RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态与动作统一到视觉空间，复用视频VAE与生成骨干，并用场景、模态、状态奖励模型做一致性后训练，以支撑闭环策略回放与GRPO更新。在四项真实操作任务中，世界模型与真实成功率的相关均值由0.602升至0.885，策略后训练将π0.5真实成功率从59.1%提至70.8%。
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.

papers.title_en: Width and Depth Limits Commute During Training
papers.evidence: Depth-μP缩放下的残差网络宽度-深度极限理论
papers.tldr: 无限宽与无限深极限是否在训练中可交换，是理解残差网络尺度极限的关键问题。论文在线性残差网络、Depth-μP 的 1/√depth 分支缩放和 μP 宽度参数化下，分析固定步数梯度下降的训练动态。作者证明带梯度裁剪时，沿任意联合宽度—深度增长路径，网络输出在 L2 意义下收敛，因而两个极限在整个有限训练时域内可交换。无裁剪时 L2 收敛一般不成立，但可得到概率收敛的较弱结论，为训练尺度极限理论补上关键一环。
papers.abstract_en: Recent work established that the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits of residual networks commute at initialization when residual branches are scaled by $1/\sqrt{depth}$. In particular, the network output converges to the same limit whether width and depth tend to infinity sequentially or jointly. We extend this commutativity result to training in linear residual networks. Under the same $1/\sqrt{depth}$ residual-branch scaling (Depth-$μ$P) and the $μ$P width parameterization, we prove that, for any fixed number of gradient-descent steps with gradient clipping, the network output converges in $L^2$ along every joint width--depth growth path as both width and depth tend to infinity. Consequently, the infinite-width and infinite-depth limits commute throughout any finite training horizon. Without gradient clipping, the corresponding $L^2$ convergence does not hold in general, but we establish the weaker convergence in probability.

papers.title_en: Not an Accident: Exploiting Safety Filter Inadequacy in Humanoid Robots
papers.authors: Tiffany Bao, Shangtao Li, Yifan Sun, Mengwen He, Bowei Li, Alden Wang, Changliu Liu, Ruoyu Wang, David Brumley
papers.evidence: 人形机器人控制中的安全滤波器与硬性避碰保证
papers.tldr: 人形机器人进入家庭、医院和仓库后，安全过滤器被视为避免碰撞的关键保障，但其保证依赖任务与环境相关的正确参数配置，部署后可能失效。本文提出目标插入攻击，并开发自动化工具 SIREN，为给定任务与环境搜索可触发安全违规的插入目标。实验在 SPARK 数据集中识别出所有脆弱场景的攻击，攻击数量为基线三倍，并能在真实人形机器人上造成碰撞。结果表明现有安全机制本身可成为安全风险来源。
papers.abstract_en: As humanoid robots move from research laboratories toward deployment in human-centered environments such as homes, hospitals, and warehouses, safe operation around nearby people and objects becomes a fundamental requirement. Safety filters have emerged as a promising technique to address this challenge by providing mathematical guarantees that generated control actions do not result in collisions.   This paper shows that these guarantees hold only when the safety parameters are configured correctly. However, correct parameter configurations are task- and environment-specific, and no general method exists to determine them across diverse deployments. As a result, safety filters shipped with humanoid robots can fail after deployment in specific scenarios. We show that attackers can exploit these failures through only normal user interactions without any additional privileges or capabilities. To demonstrate this risk, we present goal insertion attacks and develop SIREN, an automated tool that identifies vulnerable inserting goals for a given task and environment. Experimental results show that SIREN identifies attacks in all vulnerable scenarios in the SPARK dataset. Compared with a baseline approach, SIREN discovers three times as many attacks. We also show that SIREN is able to generate attacks against a real humanoid and cause it to collide while executing tasks. These results demonstrate that current safety filters introduce exploitable vulnerabilities that can cause safety violations, which reveals that existing safety mechanisms can themselves become a source of safety risk for humanoid robots.

papers.title_en: Sparsity-driven emergence of functional modularity in multitask neural networks
papers.authors: Bowen Shi, Qi Ouyang, Long Qian
papers.evidence: 稀疏正则化促使多任务网络结构形成模块化任务选择性子网络
papers.tldr: 多任务神经网络能学习多个任务，但学习如何把共享计算组织成专用且可复用的组件仍不清楚。本文用稀疏诱导正则训练多层感知机和轻量Transformer，并通过功能剖析识别出紧凑、任务选择性的子网络，称为功能令牌。结果显示这些令牌优先在较深层形成专化，浅层保留共享计算；选择性保留令牌可维持对应功能而降低其他任务表现，且提取的令牌能经替代通路重组，在免重训下重构已学复合计算。该工作表明稀疏约束不仅改变参数使用，也塑造学习计算的组织与复用方式。
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show that sparsity inducing regularization promotes functional modularity in multitask networks without predefined module boundaries. Using functional profiling in multilayer perceptrons and a lightweight transformer, we identified compact, task-selective subnetworks, termed functional tokens. Across rule-based task families, selectively retaining these tokens preserves their associated functions while reducing performance on other tasks. Such specialization develops preferentially in deeper layers during training, while earlier layers retain shared computation. Regularization strength and form shape module compactness and specialization, while task weighting alters functional allocation. Moreover, extracted functional tokens can be recombined through alternative pathways to reconstruct a learned composite computation without retraining, preserving their connectivity and learned weights. Our results suggest that sparsity-constrained optimization shapes not only parameter use but also the organization and reuse of learned computation.

papers.title_en: FOCUS: A Lightweight Mamba-2 Model for EEG-Based Cognitive Workload Classification
papers.authors: Ioannis Kyprakis, Stefanos Gkikas, Chariklia Chatzaki, Zongyi Jiang, Randy Gomez, Raul Fernandez Rojas
papers.evidence: 结合深度可分离卷积的轻量高效模型
papers.tldr: 针对高风险场景中基于EEG的认知负荷连续监测需求，作者提出轻量Mamba-2模型FOCUS，用固定FFT分解覆盖五个经典频段，避免从数据学习频率敏感度。模型结合深度可分离卷积与权重共享的编码器-瓶颈Mamba-2对，仅0.04M参数和0.11 GFLOPs。11名受试者三任务LOSO试点中，全数据集准确率74.75%，GPU前向延迟0.08 ms。权重共享消融提升4.55个百分点但未达显著（p=0.083），整体显示性能与计算成本的较好折中。
papers.abstract_en: Cognitive workload estimation from physiological signals is increasingly relevant in high-risk environments, where continuous and unobtrusive monitoring can inform adaptive systems and safety interventions. This paper presents FOCUS (Frequency-band Optimized Cognitive-load Ultralight SSM), a compact Mamba-2-based model for EEG-based binary workload classification under constrained data conditions. Rather than learning frequency sensitivity from data, FOCUS encodes preprocessed multi-channel EEG using a fixed FFT decomposition that covers the five canonical EEG bands. The proposed model combines depthwise-separable convolution and a weight-shared encoder-bottleneck Mamba-2 pair, with 0.04 million parameters and 0.11 GFLOPs. Evaluated in a pilot study with 11 participants under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation across three cognitively distinct tasks, FOCUS achieves 74.75% accuracy on the full dataset at 0.08 ms GPU model-forward latency. In the weight-sharing ablation, the shared configuration achieves 4.55 percentage points higher accuracy on the full dataset than the non-shared variant while reducing the SSM parameter budget; however, this difference does not reach statistical significance under a two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test ($p=0.083$). Overall, the selected FOCUS configuration provides a favorable trade-off between classification performance and computational cost within this controlled pilot setting.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory
papers.authors: Chenbei Lu, Zaiwei Chen, Tongxin Li, Chenye Wu, Adam Wierman
papers.evidence: 含转移预测MDP的贝叶斯贝尔曼方程与动态规划
papers.tldr: 多步转移预测有望提升强化学习，但直接纳入状态会造成状态空间指数增长且价值难以量化。论文在块反馈协议下研究折扣有限MDP，证明最优值满足原状态空间上的贝叶斯Bellman方程，并用Bellman-Jensen分析揭示预测通过调整最大化与期望顺序创造价值。作者提出BF-BOLA模型算法，给出匹配至对数因子的样本复杂度上下界，表明预测可减少转移学习并降低近优策略学习的样本需求。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in the state can lead to exponential state-space growth, making direct dynamic programming computationally expensive. We study discounted finite MDPs under a block-feedback protocol: at the start of each K-period block, the decision maker observes $K$-step probabilistic transition predictions for a subset of actions and adapts decisions to observed states within the block. We show that the optimal value satisfies a Bayesian Bellman equation on the original state space. This representation reveals that predictive information creates value by recursively changing the local order of maximization and expectation in the Bellman expansion. We formalize this effect through a Bellman--Jensen analysis and quantify the effects of prediction horizon, error, action coverage, and within-block feedback. We propose block-feedback Bayesian offline learning with online adaptation (BF--BOLA), a model-based algorithm for learning near-optimal policies, and establish upper and lower sample-complexity bounds that match up to logarithmic factors in the stated regimes. The results show that predictions can reduce transition learning to uncovered rows and that learning a near-optimal policy can require fewer prediction samples than estimating the Bayesian value function.

papers.title_en: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
papers.authors: Xi Chen, Fengqi Hu, Zeyu Shen, Jiaying Xu, Shangding Gu, Pan Xu, Anqi Liu, Laixi Shi
papers.evidence: 鲁棒与安全强化学习算法的统一基准库
papers.tldr: 稳健强化学习对真实部署至关重要，但现有算法复用性不足且经验能力边界不清。RobustRLlib以统一接口集成17种在线、离线与安全稳健RL算法，并构建覆盖真实偏移及人形与视觉语言动作任务的评测平台。系统评估273种扰动配置，给出当前稳健RL能力图谱，揭示有效场景与仍存差距。该开源基准提升可复现性与可扩展性，支撑新问题应用和新算法开发。
papers.abstract_en: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.
